plan.title: Scholarship Scheme Progress by District
plan.subtitle: Overview of application status, scheme distribution, and pending cases across districts

panels.title: Pending Cases
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS pending FROM "scholarship_applicants" WHERE "Status" = 'Pending'

panels.title: Approved & Disbursed
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS completed FROM "scholarship_applicants" WHERE "Status" IN ('Approved', 'Disbursed')

panels.title: Application Status by District
panels.sql: SELECT "District" AS district, SUM(CASE WHEN "Status" = 'Approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approved, SUM(CASE WHEN "Status" = 'Disbursed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS disbursed, SUM(CASE WHEN "Status" = 'Pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending, SUM(CASE WHEN "Status" = 'Rejected' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejected, SUM(CASE WHEN "Status" = 'Under Review' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS under_review FROM "scholarship_applicants" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Pending Cases by District
panels.sql: SELECT "District" AS district, COUNT(*) AS pending_count FROM "scholarship_applicants" WHERE "Status" = 'Pending' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Pending Applications by Scheme and District
panels.sql: SELECT "Name of scheme" AS scheme, "District" AS district, COUNT(*) AS pending_count FROM "scholarship_applicants" WHERE "Status" = 'Pending' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 20

plan.narrative:
The dashboard tracks scholarship application progress across districts, highlighting total volume, completed cases, and pending items. The total number of applications is {{p1}}, with {{p2}} currently pending and {{p3}} already approved or disbursed.

The stacked bar chart shows the status breakdown by district, allowing quick identification of areas with high pending or rejected counts. The bar chart isolates pending cases by district, with the highest pending count in {{p5}}.

The table lists the top pending applications by scheme and district, with the most common pending scheme-district combination being {{p6}}.
